title: project.open
description: Open an existing project file, or create a new empty project when 'path' is omitted. Renamed 1:1 from the legacy 'open_project' tool to OPP/1 section 8.2 project.open. The transaction token is supplied by the T1 adapter; tool callers never see 'txn'.

path.description: Path to an existing project file. Omit to create a new empty project (tool-level extension: OPP/1 v1 always passes a path).

fps.description: Frame rate: a positive integer frames-per-second value (e.g. 30) or a rational {num, den} (e.g. {num: 30000, den: 1001} for 29.97). Bare floats such as 29.97 are rejected. Only used when creating a new project.

name.description: Name of the sequence created for a new project.
